name: LAB 01 — Power Control
summary: BKC-visible start, stop, wait, and status lane for the lab using the existing ops/lab-power.sh contract.
operator_rule: Use this pipeline or ops/lab-power.sh for lab lifecycle. IPMI actions are routed through ns1; do not rediscover BMC handling from scratch.

with.summary: Record lab power action, reachable hosts, failed SSH/IPMI hops, and next operator step.

notes: The underlying script already knows ns1, edge, BMC addresses, R730 password-file override, health checks, and parking behavior. This pipeline just makes those actions visible and repeatable from BKC.
